labels.registered: declared here before any fit of MM1-v3.2
labels.desk: computed at a desk from committed files
labels.post hoc: fitted or read after its data existed
labels.held out: left out of the fit that scores it (not blind)
labels.blind: scored on data that did not exist when the forecast was frozen
labels.unread: data existed, no lane shaping the model read them
labels.REPORTED: printed beside a rule, never deciding it
labels.NOT RUN: a check that did not run
labels.error: forecast / measured - 1; rms and bias in %

unread_e214.verdict: pass rule FAIL on part A; part S PASS

T.name: the time form
T.form: T5r+G0+n32 exactly as tools/matmul/mm1/v3.1/time_v31.py Engine31 computes it
T.reopened_v31_items: none (item 8 T5r, item 3 G0, item 4 n/32 with T7 out stand)
T.layout_factor: T = T_base x clip(1 + sum a_i x_i, 0.3, 3.0) at subset points of rgm136 gemmL when item L chooses a term; else T = T_base
T.T7: not refitted; REPORTED only where earlier files froze it

E.name: the energy form
E.form: E1t exactly as tools/matmul/mm1/v3.1/energy_v31.py W31(..., 'E1t') computes it, plus F3

F3.equation: dW = D x sL x (n / t_op) x 1e-12 x (c1 x dup + c2 x first)  [W over idle]
F3.dup: 26 at every rgm136 gemmLnc point; 0 at every cooperative loop (rgm136 gemmL, rgm211 gemmL and gemmLn, run_gemm)
F3.first: (14 qA_b + 12 qB_b) / NB, qA_b, qB_b = 1 - the L2 marginals of Q = (Q0 + Q1)/2 at the fold time constants; NB the arm N blocks
F3.t_op: seconds: measured for given-t quantities and in the energy fit; forecast otherwise
F3.D: 1 + 0.0048 (die - 50 C), the run start die (50 C at a forecast with none given)

c1_c2.kind: linear constants in each start linear solve, clipped into bounds

F3.source: tools/matmul/mm1/v3.2-terms/gemmlnc/term-gemmlnc.json with its dated note 1 three readings
F3.refit: jointly with every other energy constant on all of a fold training energy points; the two columns are zero except at the gemmLnc points (E211 c01c, c02c; E213 a075, a079, a082, a086, a087, k37, k40; E215 a024, a026, a031, a032, b013, those that ran), which alone identify c1, c2; the gemmL twins at the same shapes and cards price the base the term sits on

E.xi: free in [0, 1], pinned 1 in a fold with no governed card

counts.merge: in memory as DECLARED-unread-e214.md section e (no key collides: asserted)

E.phi: v3.1 item 7 precedence; E214 kinds as DECLARED-unread-e214.md read them: kinds_v3.phi over each new kind registered tile file (sha256 against E214 arms.json); pattern:sparse50f/h/i as sparse50; fp32 pattern:sp_ar4 gate (g_op, g_lane, g8) = (0.5, 0, 0); no count or no phi: NOT FORECAST in energy
E.fit_footing: W over idle given the measured op time; residual (W - W_meas) / max(W_meas, 3 W)

F3_pins.c1: free when the fold training energy points of rgm136 gemmLnc number at least 1; else pinned 0
F3_pins.c2: free when those points number at least 3, their values of first take at least 2 distinct values (rounded to 1e-9), and the columns [w_i S_i dup_i, w_i S_i first_i] (S_i = D_i sL_i n_i / t_i x 1e-12, w_i the fit weight, each column scaled to unit norm) have condition number at most 100; else pinned 0

route.decides: v3.1 item 2 fallback (MM1-v3's declared rule: training cards' mean Pa, kc = 1; AMENDMENT-A2.md pin without aifoundry3)
route.why: v3.1's own not-wanted condition for the anchor route read True (10.92% vs 9.64%)

L.name: the layout term: at most one

F1: Phi_fresh at 32 MB (the walk strict-LRU DRAM lines a step over line requests a step, minus the full chip)

features.F1_check: v01_map fresh32 Phi equals features_layout.py + eval_layout.phi_of Phi_fresh within 1e-5 at every subset configuration; else F1 takes features_layout value (named)
features.key: rgm136.gemmL|<MB>x<NB>x<KB>|0x<mask> beside the shape full-chip key
features.L3_conventions: lock-step stream, strict LRU at the stated capacity, C stores allocating, pools 4 KiB aligned, lines over 32 L3 homes by PA[10:6], 8 memory shires by PA[8:6]
features.scope: subset points of rgm136 gemmL; any other subset point takes no term

L.fit: two-stage: per fold, a = normal-equation solution over the fold training subset points (E146 store rungs out) of (r_i (1 + M_i a) - 1)^2, r_i = T_base,i / T_meas,i (lstsq where singular); held out T_base x clip(1 + M a, 0.3, 3.0); all-data constants on every training subset point

scores.LOEO_nt: pooled wall rms over every point the 20 main LOEO folds hold out, twins excluded
scores.LOLO: wall rms over every subset point, each by its class LOLO fold (compact n = 4R; spread R = min(8, n); else other; n = 1 other), eta pin
scores.LOCO_sub: per card, rms over its subset points in its LOCO fold; the term constants in each of the four LOCO folds

ii_bootstrap.how: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, n, size=(10000, n)); 97.5th percentile of rms_c - rms_none < 0

rule.iv_sign: each constant one strict sign in all four LOCO folds

selection_placebo.how: one permutation of the subset points applied to every feature column alike; eligibility and choice re-run; d_i = LOLO(winner_i) - LOLO_none (0 with none)

labels_REPORTED.placement_if: LOLO below at least 950 of 1000 permutations within (n, arm token, card) groups, seed 20261123 + i

rule.not_identified: a factor within 1% of 1 at every point (|sum a_i x_i| <= 0.01)

desk_check_REPORTED.selftest: PASS (null -> none; planted N3 -> N3, p_sel 0.005 with 200 permutations)
desk_check_REPORTED.rule_on_real_data: NOT RUN (decides only on MM1-v3.2 fits)

time.starts: S0-S5 MM1-v3 declared starts, S6-S17 the seeded draws recorded in declared-v31.json, restricted to the 19 names (copied here)

optimizer.phase_1: scipy least_squares on forecast / measured - 1 of the wall op time, every training point weight 1, x_scale 'jac', diff_step 1e-4, ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-8, at most 4,000 evaluations, each of the 18 starts
optimizer.phase_2: the three lowest phase-1 costs continued from their end points at ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-12, at most 4,000 evaluations a leg, restarted from the last point while the cost falls by more than 1e-9 relative, at most 5 legs
optimizer.winner: the lowest phase-2 training cost; ties within 1e-9 relative to the lower start index
optimizer.basins: two continued solutions share a basin when their costs agree within 1e-6 relative; reported per fold: every start's phase-1 cost, status and evaluations, the three continued costs and held-out rms, the winner's start, and how many of the 18 phase-1 costs lie within 1e-3 relative of the winner's; a fold whose winner one start alone reached is flagged (no change of rule)

time.basins: the lowest phase-2 training cost wins (ties within 1e-9 relative to the lower start index)

pins.eta: pinned 0 in any fold whose training set holds no point with the row-imbalance flag (subset mask, all four column groups, fewer than eight row groups)

energy.starts: 9: MM1-v3's three (the linear solve at kc 1, xi 1, m 1, eC 1, then kc / xi / m 1.05 / 0.5 / 1.2 and 0.95 / 0.9 / 2.0) and 6 draws numpy.random.default_rng(20261119).uniform over the boxes below; each start's linear constants from the linear solve at its nonlinear values, clipped into bounds (E1b's b2, d2 to >= 0)
energy.optimizer: least_squares on (W - W_meas) / max(W_meas, 3 W), ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-12, at most 3,000 evaluations; the lowest cost wins
energy.each_fold_reads: its own time fold phase-2 winner (lines, op times, retention, F3 first)

fits.layout: two-stage on each fold time winner (items.L); changes subset op times only

MM1-v3.1, MM1-v3 blind error on E215 by family; 'v3.1 + gemmLnc term', 'v3.1 + contention', verify-lay controls on E215 points

planning_line.PP: max W over idle at own seconds at 600 MHz over MM1-v3.2, MM1-v3.1, MM1-v3, MM1-v2, v3.1 + gemmLnc term, v3.1 + contention (each where it prices) + rest law at T0 forecast (54.4 C) + 2 W

common.draws: random.Random("v3.2-blind|E218|<family>|<stratum>").sample of the stratum remaining qualifying candidates sorted by that string

grid.formats: fp32 in every regime; int8 also in L2

G.score: |ln(W_v3.2 / W_v3.1)| of W over idle at own seconds; ceil(q/2) by descending score, the rest by the regime draw
G.qualifies: token and twin token never ran on the card; both PP < 67.0 W; shape new to E218; no drawn G point shares its (NB, KB, format)
G.twin_Gt: rgm136 gemmL<MB>x<NB>x<KB> same format and data, full chip (F3 exactly 0 there)
G.order: the G block LAST: smoke s03 gemmLnc2x2x2 fp32 (its family stop path), G points by PP ascending, then reversed; Gt in passes 1 and 2

Y.pair: two masks of one n at one shape (15 a shape and count)
Y.score: D_p = max_c d_c(p) - min_c d_c(p), d_c(p) = ln(T_c(mask a) / T_c(mask b)) at 600 MHz over the seven candidates at MM1-v3.2 all-data two-stage constants
Y.draw: six pairs by descending D_p (at most one pair a shape), then two control pairs: the smallest D_p among pairs with |d_none| <= 0.0005, at shapes new to E218
Y.ids: y01a/y01b ... y08b, lower mask first; y01-y06 rank order, y07-y08 controls

F.draw: ceil(q/2) by descending score, the rest by the format draw

e218.order: smoke s01 gemmL2x2x2 fp32 (gate); tie t01 (E206 p001 gemmL2x4x4 fp32 random full chip); pass 1 (Gt, Y, F in random.Random("E218|A|pass1") shuffle of sorted ids); tie; pass 2 (reversed); tie; the G block
e218.run_form: die gate min(60, rest die + 4) C (300 s, else NO DATA); 10 s at rest; one host process --seconds 6 --budget 7.5 under plain timeout 10 (never -k); 4 s tail

stops.board: strictly above 70 W on 3 samples in a row
stops.latch: at or above 70 C once risen
stops.how: the host stop file, never a kill

MM1-v3.2 without its layout term (if one entered)

decision_order: 1. at the fit start: every input sha256, E215 blob ids, the E215 scores gate, the feature agreement check, the census-path record as v3.1 left it
2. time: T5r+G0+n32 on every fold (the eta pin): MM1-v3.2 base and MM1-v3 refitted time
3. the layout term: the bundle from step 2; layout_rule_v32.py decide -> the term or none
4. energy: E1t + F3 on every fold (F3 pins); E1u (v3 refitted) on every fold; each on its time fold
6. freeze MM1-v3.2 (land); then E218 points and forecasts at its registration

a card factor for F3 (card 1 reads 6-10% above it)
